V1: Add JWT token auth with djangorestframework-simplejwt to a DRF backend replacing cookie sessions for a mobile app, with short access tokens, longer refresh tokens, and refresh blacklisting on logout.
V2: Debug Django users randomly logged out after scaling to multiple servers behind a load balancer, likely due to session storage, per-instance caches or inconsistent SECRET_KEY, requiring shared session backend or sticky sessions.
V3: Fix flaky Playwright end-to-end tests in a Next.js app that time out on page.click of the login button only in GitHub Actions CI but pass locally, e.g. hydration timing, viewport or headless environment differences.
V4: Fix a flaky Jest test for a React custom hook with a countdown timer where jest.useFakeTimers combined with await waitFor never resolves, due to fake timer and async polling interaction.
V5: Plan a near-zero-downtime major version upgrade of a large (~2TB) AWS Aurora PostgreSQL cluster from 11 to 15, choosing between RDS blue/green deployments and pglogical logical replication.
V6: Create a new composite index on a very large production PostgreSQL table without blocking writes, using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY and handling lock and invalid-index pitfalls.
V7: Fix Rust compile error that std::sync::MutexGuard cannot be sent between threads safely (not Send) when held across an await in an async axum handler, e.g. by scoping the guard or using tokio Mutex.
V8: Write Terraform to host a static docs website on AWS with a private S3 bucket behind CloudFront using origin access control, a custom domain, ACM certificate and HTTPS via Route53.
V9: Diagnose Spring Boot container OOMKilled with exit code 137 in Kubernetes under load despite normal heap metrics, investigating off-heap memory, metaspace, thread stacks, direct buffers and JVM container memory settings versus the 2Gi limit.
V10: Modernize a Python package's packaging by migrating from setup.py to pyproject.toml with the Hatch build backend, dynamic git-tag-based versioning, and publishing to PyPI from GitHub Actions using trusted publishing OIDC.
